changelog: v0.10.0 Feature Release: Complete feature parity between PC and Mobile. Ported Bookmarks to PC with dedicated store, bookmarks route, BookmarksGrid, TabBar integration, and anime detail quick action. Ported Custom Playlists & Watch Orders to Mobile with Room database entities, migration, repository, and sequencer screen. Implemented persistent global playlist picking mode across Discover, Home, My List, and Calendar with Cancel (0 additions) vs. Done & Return to Playlist buttons. Added anime detail quick actions (Bookmark, Add to Playlist, Copy Title, Share).
